newsitem.title: USA: MCI and NextWave in carrier deal.
newsitem.headline: MCI and NextWave in carrier deal.

text.p: MCI and NextWave Telecommunications Inc said Wednesday they agreed for MCI to provide carrier services to NextWave in return for the use of NextWave's system to provide wireless local access.

"The arrangement will provide NextWave with the tools to build a cost-effective, state-of-the-art wireless network," the companies said in a statement. "It will also furnish MCI with real-time visibily into MCI's traffic over the NextWave personal communications services (PCS) network."

They said the agreement marked a step toward offering more affordable personal communications services to the public. PCS refers to a service with higher sound quality and the ability to personalize features, such as caller identification and voicemail notification.
NextWave has the third largest wireless franchise in the United States. MCI, headquartered in Washington D.C., provides communication services to more than 20 million customers, the statement said.
